# UX Checklist: ART-005 - Gallery Completion - Knowledge, Reports & Editors

**Purpose**: Validate UX requirements quality for the seven ART-005 gallery artifact slices before task generation and implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist ux` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the seven UX surfaces and their reader versus producer roles explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-005, Research §Preserve Reader/Producer Classification]
- [x] CHK002 Are functional-fidelity requirements defined as preserving each pinned source's content model or interaction purpose while applying Racecraft gallery constraints, rather than copying upstream pixels? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Assumptions, Design Concept §Q6]
- [x] CHK003 Are representative fill slots and minimum anchored sample-content floors specified for every ART-005 artifact? [Completeness, Spec §Source, Fidelity, and Fill Regions, Contract §Gallery Template]
- [x] CHK004 Are visible empty, limit, and invalid-state requirements specified for every user-changeable ART-005 surface, including concept-explainer controls and the three editor workflows? [Resolved, Spec §UX Boundary And Responsive Criteria, Spec §FR-021, Contract §UX Boundary And Responsive States, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports, Data Model §EditorSessionState, Quickstart §Manual file:// Checks]
- [x] CHK005 Are the preserved upstream interaction mechanisms documented per artifact so implementers can keep UX fidelity without importing prohibited upstream behavior? [Traceability, Spec §Source, Fidelity, and Fill Regions, Plan §Reverified Upstream Measurement]

## Interaction Feedback And State

- [x] CHK006 Is the exact `Copy as Markdown` label specified for each producer and excluded from reader artifacts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]
- [x] CHK007 Are clipboard success and failure feedback messages exact, text-based, and tied to the visible manual-copy recovery path? [Clarity, Spec §Clipboard behavior, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]
- [x] CHK008 Are editor session-reset requirements clear that working content resets on reload while existing theme preference behavior remains unchanged? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Research §Keep State Session-Only]
- [x] CHK009 Are producer exports defined from live visible state at invocation time with deterministic ordering, schemas, and edge-value rules? [Measurability, Spec §Editor State and Export Contracts, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]
- [x] CHK010 Are transient reader interactions, especially slide navigation and concept simulation controls, specified without implying durable export state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Plan §Slice 1, Plan §Slice 2]

## Responsive And File UX

- [x] CHK011 Are direct `file://`, no-server, no-sibling-asset, offline-readable requirements specified for every new artifact? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Contract §Gallery Template, SPA Contract §Single-file rule]
- [x] CHK012 Are responsive viewport requirements measurable for mobile and desktop review, including no clipped or overlapping text and no page-level horizontal overflow except documented named scroll regions? - [x] CHK013 Are horizontal-scroll UX requirements consistent with keyboard focus, programmatic naming, and actual-scroll-element evidence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Contract §UAT Evidence, Checklist §accessibility]
- [x] CHK014 Are color, status, priority, warning, and error meanings required to remain understandable without relying on color alone? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, Contract §Gallery Template, SPA Contract §Color is never the only carrier of meaning]
- [x] CHK015 Are reduced-motion requirements specified for all seven artifacts without leaving required navigation or simulation behavior motion-dependent? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-006, Plan §Slice UAT increments]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Are UAT evidence requirements complete enough to prove direct open, representative content, offline reload, keyboard traversal, focus, themes, reduced motion, color-independent meaning, and editor clipboard recovery? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Acceptance Evidence and Reviewability, Contract §UAT Evidence]

- [x] CHK018 Are reader artifacts measurable as complete standalone experiences without requiring export controls? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-006]

- [x] CHK020 Are success criteria traceable to the major UX outcomes of shipped file usability, complete content, deterministic editor export, clipboard recovery, and UAT coverage? [Traceability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-004, Spec §SC-007]

## Slice Reviewability And Scope

- [x] CHK021 Are the seven sequential slices independently usable and reviewable, with each slice owning exactly one template's UX completion and UAT increment? [Consistency, Spec §Review Topology Resolution, Contract §Slice Topology]
- [x] CHK022 Are shared gallery branding, canonical blocks, manifest changes, tests, generated artifacts, and UAT files serialized so no later slice must repair an earlier slice's UX? [Consistency, Plan §Slice Stack And Branch Plan, Contract §Slice Topology]
- [x] CHK023 Are non-goals clear enough to prevent UX scope creep into routing, storage, import, automatic downloads, JSON export kinds, shared foundation changes, or already-shipped template repairs? [Scope, Spec §FR-019, Design Concept §Non-goals]
- [x] CHK024 Are projected per-slice reviewability ceilings recorded and below the 800-LOC block after already accepted accessibility remediation? [Scope, Plan §Reviewability Checkpoint]
- [x] CHK025 Are generated artifact and installed-cache outputs treated as source-derived validation surfaces rather than hand-authored UX deliverables? [Consistency, Plan §Declared File Operations, Constitution §Cross-Platform Runtime & Script Safety]
